phase_prompt.summary: Base state of the ancient‑tech house with integrated crystalline core and bioluminescent moss.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A towering stone house blending rugged basalt walls of ancient Ethiopian architecture with sunken hieroglyphic circuitry of Egyptian temples, featuring a copper‑gabled roof, a central crystalline core emitting soft bioluminescent glow, moss‑laden stone doors with magnetic levitation, hidden chambers accessed by pressure‑sensitive glyphs, and a network of bio‑luminescent algae panels illuminating the interior at night, rendered in photorealistic, tactile detail with warm golden light and subtle reflections on tempered obsidian glass surfaces.
